nodes.long_description:
ボールを打ち出し、フリッパーを操作して、究極のVRピンボールアーケードへ。**Pinball Universe VR**へようこそ。これは1台だけのピンボールではありません。遊び、極め、探索できるピンボールの世界が集まったアーケードです。

4つのオリジナルピンボール台には、それぞれ独自のミッション、アート、ライト、サウンド、雰囲気があります。

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — 炎に包まれた洞窟で、ドラゴンが守る秘宝を狙おう。

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — 宇宙、スターシップ、メカ戦闘の中で銀河を守ろう。

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — 色鮮やかなDía de los Muertosの夜を光とターゲットで楽しもう。

🐙 Octopus Island — 明るい南国の海で、楽しくエネルギッシュな冒険に飛び込もう。

リアルなピンボール物理、反応の良いフリッパー、なめらかなボールの動き、光るプレイフィールド、没入感のあるサウンドが、VRの中で各マシンを生き生きと動かします。繰り返し遊べるテーブルミッションをクリアし、ハイスコアを狙い、ゲーム内キャッシュを獲得し、トロフィー、賞品、フィギュア、装飾を集めて進行を楽しみましょう。

ピンボールだけではありません。ダーツを投げたり、バスケットマシンでシュートしたり、自動販売機でドリンクを手に取ったりしながら、熱いピンボールプレイの合間に自分だけのレトロアーケードでくつろげます。

**Pinball Universe VR**は、スキル重視のピンボールシミュレーションと、何度も戻りたくなるカラフルなアーケード空間を組み合わせたゲームです。すべての台を遊び、すべてのボールを極め、報酬を集め、夢のアーケードを作り上げましょう。
nodes.short_description: Pinball Universe VRで、究極のVRピンボールアーケードへ。Dragon’s Treasure Cave、Galaxy Defender Strike、Skull Flower Fiesta、Octopus Islandの4つのオリジナルテーマ台をプレイ。リアルな物理、反応の良いフリッパー、光と音の演出、ミッション、キャッシュ、トロフィー、賞品、ダーツ、バスケットを楽しみ、自分だけの夢のアーケードを作ろう。

nodes.long_description:
Starte die Kugel, drücke die Flipper und tauche ein in die ultimative VR-Flipper-Arcade — willkommen in **Pinball Universe VR**! Dies ist nicht nur ein einzelner Tisch, sondern eine Arcade voller Pinball-Welten in VR für Fans.

Tritt an vier originale Flipper-Tische heran, jeder mit eigenen Missionen, Grafik, Licht, Sound und Atmosphäre:

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — plündere eine feurige Höhle und jage den Schatz des Drachen.

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — kämpfe durch Weltraum, Raumschiffe und Mech-Gefechte.

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — feiere eine farbenfrohe Día-de-los-Muertos-Nacht voller Lichter und Ziele.

🐙 Octopus Island — tauche in ein tropisches Ozeanabenteuer voller Energie ein.

Spüre authentische Flipperphysik, reaktionsschnelle Flipper, flüssige Kugelbewegung, leuchtende Spielfelder und immersive Sounds. Erfülle wiederholbare Tischmissionen, jage Highscores, verdiene Ingame-Cash und sammle Trophäen, Preise, Figuren und Dekorationen, die deinen Fortschritt zeigen.

Mehr als Pinball: Die Arcade bietet zusätzliche Möglichkeiten zum Spielen und Entspannen. Wirf Darts, triff Körbe am Basketball-Automaten, hol dir ein Getränk am Automaten und genieße die Atmosphäre deiner Retro-Arcade zwischen intensiven Flipper-Runden.

Pinball Universe VR verbindet skillbasierte Flipper-Simulation mit einem farbenfrohen Arcade-Raum. Spiele die Tische, meistere jeden Ball, sammle Belohnungen und baue deine Traum-Arcade, einen perfekten Schuss nach dem anderen.
nodes.short_description: Betritt Pinball Universe VR — die ultimative VR-Flipper-Arcade! Spiele vier originale Tische, jeder als eigene Themenwelt: Dragon’s Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta und Octopus Island. Erlebe realistische Flipperphysik, schnelle Flipper, immersive Lichter und Sounds. Erfülle Missionen, verdiene Cash, sammle Trophäen und Preise, und entspanne mit Darts, Basketball und mehr Arcade-Spaß. Meistere jeden Ball und baue deine Traum-Arcade.

nodes.long_description:
Launch the ball, fire the flippers, and dive into the ultimate VR pinball arcade — welcome to Pinball Universe VR! This isn't just one table. It's a whole universe of pinball waiting to be explored.

Step up to four original pinball tables, each a fully themed world with its own missions, artwork, and atmosphere:

🐉 Dragon's Treasure Cave — raid a fiery hoard guarded by a mighty dragon

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — battle through deep space and mech warfare

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebrate a vibrant Día de los Muertos night

🐙 Octopus Island — dive into a bright tropical ocean adventure

Feel authentic pinball physics, responsive flippers, dynamic lighting, and immersive sound that bring every table to life in VR.

Play, earn, and collect. Complete repeatable table missions and rack up high scores to earn in-game cash. Spend it on trophies, collectibles, and prizes to personalize your arcade and show off your skill.

More than pinball. Take a break with fun arcade games like darts and basketball, grab a drink, and hang out in your own retro arcade — then get right back to the tables.

A growing universe. New pinball tables and games are always on the way, so there's always more to master.

Whether you're chasing the perfect ball, hunting a new high score, or building your dream arcade, Pinball Universe VR delivers deep, skill-based pinball wrapped in a colorful world you'll want to return to again and again.
Grab a machine, pull the plunger, and start your pinball adventure today!
nodes.short_description: Step into Pinball Universe VR — a whole arcade of pinball at your fingertips! Play four original tables, each a fully themed world: Dragon's Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta, and Octopus Island. Real physics, responsive flippers, immersive lights and sound. Complete table missions, earn cash, and collect trophies and prizes. Take a break with darts, basketball, and more — and this universe keeps growing. Grab a machine, master every ball, and build your dream arcade!

nodes.long_description:
Lancia la pallina, aziona i flipper e tuffati nella sala arcade di flipper VR definitiva — benvenuto in **Pinball Universe VR**! Non è solo un tavolo, ma un’intera arcade di mondi pinball da giocare e dominare.

Avvicinati a quattro tavoli da flipper originali, ognuno con missioni, grafica, luci, suoni e atmosfera proprie:

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — saccheggia una caverna infuocata e insegui il tesoro nascosto del drago.

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — combatti nello spazio profondo tra astronavi e guerra meccanica.

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebra una colorata notte Día de los Muertos piena di luci e bersagli.

🐙 Octopus Island — tuffati in un’avventura tropicale luminosa, oceanica e ricca di energia.

Senti una fisica del flipper autentica, flipper reattivi, movimento fluido della pallina, piani di gioco luminosi e suoni immersivi che danno vita a ogni macchina in VR. Completa missioni ripetibili, insegui record, guadagna denaro di gioco e colleziona trofei, premi, statuette e decorazioni che mostrano i tuoi progressi.

Più che pinball, l’arcade offre pause extra. Lancia freccette, tira a canestro alla macchina da basket, prendi una bibita al distributore e goditi l’atmosfera della tua sala arcade retro tra una partita e l’altra.

Pinball Universe VR unisce simulazione di flipper basata sull’abilità e uno spazio arcade colorato in cui tornare spesso. Gioca i tavoli, domina ogni pallina, colleziona ricompense e costruisci la tua arcade dei sogni, un tiro perfetto alla volta.
nodes.short_description: Entra in Pinball Universe VR — la sala arcade di flipper VR definitiva! Gioca quattro tavoli originali, ognuno come un mondo tematico: Dragon’s Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta e Octopus Island. Prova fisica realistica, flipper reattivi, luci e suoni immersivi. Completa missioni, guadagna denaro, colleziona trofei e premi, poi rilassati con freccette, basket e altro divertimento arcade. Domina ogni pallina e crea la tua arcade dei sogni.

nodes.long_description:
發射鋼珠，操控擋板，進入終極 VR 彈珠台街機廳——歡迎來到 **Pinball Universe VR**！這不只是一張彈珠台，而是一個等待你遊玩、掌握和探索的彈珠宇宙。

走向四張原創彈珠台，每張都有自己的任務、美術、燈光、音效和氛圍：

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — 闖入炙熱洞穴，追尋巨龍守護的隱藏寶藏。

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — 穿越深空、星艦與機甲戰爭，守護銀河。

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — 在繽紛的 Día de los Muertos 之夜挑戰燈光與目標。

🐙 Octopus Island — 潛入明亮的熱帶海洋冒險，感受輕鬆有趣的島嶼能量。

體驗真實的彈珠台物理、靈敏的擋板、流暢的鋼珠運動、發光的桌面和沉浸式音效，讓每台機器在 VR 中都充滿生命力。完成可重複挑戰的桌台任務，追求更高分數，賺取遊戲內現金，並收集獎盃、獎品、角色擺件和裝飾，展示你的進度。

這裡不只有彈珠台。你還可以投擲飛鏢，在籃球機上投籃，從自動販賣機拿飲料，並在緊張的彈珠挑戰之間享受屬於自己的復古街機空間。

**Pinball Universe VR** 將技巧型彈珠台模擬與色彩豐富的街機空間結合在一起，讓你願意一次次回到這裡。遊玩每張桌台，掌握每一次擊球，收集獎勵，用一次次完美操作打造你的夢想街機廳。
nodes.short_description: 走進 Pinball Universe VR，體驗終極 VR 彈珠台街機廳！遊玩四張原創主題彈珠台：Dragon’s Treasure Cave、Galaxy Defender Strike、Skull Flower Fiesta 和 Octopus Island。感受真實彈珠物理、靈敏擋板、沉浸燈光與音效。完成任務，賺取現金，收集獎盃和獎品，再用飛鏢、籃球等街機樂趣放鬆，打造你的夢想街機廳。

nodes.long_description:
发射钢球，操控挡板，进入终极 VR 弹珠台街机厅——欢迎来到 **Pinball Universe VR**！这不只是一张弹珠台，而是一个等待你游玩、掌握和探索的弹珠宇宙。

走向四张原创弹珠台，每张都有自己的任务、美术、灯光、音效和氛围：

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — 闯入炽热洞穴，追寻巨龙守护的隐藏宝藏。

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — 穿越深空、星舰与机甲战争，守护银河。

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — 在绚丽的 Día de los Muertos 之夜挑战灯光与目标。

🐙 Octopus Island — 潜入明亮的热带海洋冒险，感受轻松有趣的岛屿能量。

体验真实的弹珠台物理、灵敏的挡板、流畅的钢球运动、发光的桌面和沉浸式音效，让每台机器在 VR 中都充满生命力。完成可重复挑战的桌台任务，冲击更高分数，赚取游戏内现金，并收集奖杯、奖品、角色摆件和装饰，展示你的进度。

这里不只有弹珠台。你还可以投掷飞镖，在篮球机上投篮，从自动售货机拿饮料，并在紧张的弹珠挑战之间享受属于自己的复古街机空间。

**Pinball Universe VR** 将技巧型弹珠台模拟与色彩丰富的街机空间结合在一起，让你愿意一次次回到这里。游玩每张桌台，掌握每一次击球，收集奖励，用一次次完美操作打造你的梦想街机厅。
nodes.short_description: 走进 Pinball Universe VR，体验终极 VR 弹珠台街机厅！畅玩四张原创主题弹珠台：Dragon’s Treasure Cave、Galaxy Defender Strike、Skull Flower Fiesta 和 Octopus Island。感受真实弹珠物理、灵敏挡板、沉浸灯光与音效。完成任务，赚取现金，收集奖杯和奖品，再用飞镖、篮球等街机乐趣放松，打造你的梦想街机厅。

nodes.long_description:
Lanza la bola, activa los flippers y sumérgete en la arcade definitiva de pinball en VR — bienvenido a **Pinball Universe VR**! No es solo una mesa, sino toda una arcade de mundos de pinball esperando ser jugados y dominados.

Acércate a cuatro mesas de pinball originales, cada una con sus propias misiones, arte, luces, sonido y atmósfera:

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — saquea una caverna ardiente y busca el tesoro oculto del dragón.

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — lucha en el espacio profundo entre naves y guerra mecánica.

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebra una colorida noche de Día de los Muertos llena de luces y objetivos.

🐙 Octopus Island — sumérgete en una aventura tropical brillante, oceánica y llena de energía.

Siente física auténtica de pinball, flippers rápidos y precisos, movimiento suave de la bola, tableros iluminados y sonido inmersivo que da vida a cada máquina en VR. Completa misiones repetibles, persigue high scores, gana dinero del juego y colecciona trofeos, premios, figuras y decoraciones que muestran tu progreso.

nodes.long_description:
Lance a bola, acione os flippers e mergulhe no arcade definitivo de pinball em VR — bem-vindo a **Pinball Universe VR**! Não é apenas uma mesa, mas um arcade inteiro de mundos de pinball esperando para serem jogados e dominados.

Aproxime-se de quatro mesas de pinball originais, cada uma com suas próprias missões, arte, luzes, sons e atmosfera:

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — invada uma caverna em chamas e procure o tesouro escondido do dragão.

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — lute no espaço profundo entre naves, estrelas e guerra mecânica.

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebre uma noite colorida de Día de los Muertos cheia de luzes e alvos.

🐙 Octopus Island — mergulhe em uma aventura tropical, oceânica e cheia de energia.

Sinta física autêntica de pinball, flippers responsivos, movimento suave da bola, campos iluminados e som imersivo que dão vida a cada máquina em VR. Complete missões repetíveis nas mesas, busque recordes, ganhe dinheiro no jogo e colecione troféus, prêmios, figuras e decorações que mostram seu progresso.

Mais que pinball, o arcade também oferece formas extras de jogar e relaxar. Jogue dardos, arremesse na máquina de basquete, pegue uma bebida na máquina de venda e curta a atmosfera do seu próprio arcade retrô entre partidas intensas.

Pinball Universe VR combina simulação de pinball baseada em habilidade com um espaço arcade colorido para voltar muitas vezes. Jogue as mesas, domine cada bola, colecione recompensas e construa seu arcade dos sonhos, jogada por jogada.

Domine cada bola e crie seu arcade dos sonhos. em VR.

nodes.long_description:
공을 쏘아 올리고 플리퍼를 움직이며 궁극의 VR 핀볼 아케이드 속으로 들어가 보세요. **Pinball Universe VR**에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 이 게임은 단순한 하나의 핀볼 테이블이 아니라, 플레이하고 마스터하고 탐험할 수 있는 핀볼 세계가 모인 아케이드입니다.

4개의 오리지널 핀볼 테이블은 각각 고유한 미션, 아트워크, 조명, 사운드, 분위기를 가지고 있습니다.

🐉 Dragon’s Treasure Cave — 불타는 동굴을 탐험하고 드래곤이 지키는 숨겨진 보물을 노려보세요.

🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — 우주, 스타십, 메카 전투 속에서 은하를 방어하세요.

💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — 화려한 Día de los Muertos의 밤을 빛과 타깃으로 즐기세요.

🐙 Octopus Island — 밝은 열대 바다에서 활기찬 모험을 시작하세요.

현실적인 핀볼 물리, 반응 좋은 플리퍼, 부드러운 공 움직임, 빛나는 플레이필드, 몰입감 있는 사운드가 VR 속 각 머신을 생생하게 만듭니다. 반복 가능한 테이블 미션을 완료하고, 하이 스코어를 노리고, 게임 내 캐시를 벌고, 트로피, 상품, 피규어, 장식을 수집하며 진행을 즐기세요.

핀볼이 전부는 아닙니다. 다트를 던지고, 농구 머신에서 슛을 넣고, 자판기에서 음료를 뽑으며, 강렬한 핀볼 플레이 사이에 나만의 레트로 아케이드 분위기 속에서 쉬어갈 수 있습니다.

**Pinball Universe VR**은 실력 기반 핀볼 시뮬레이션과 다시 돌아오고 싶은 컬러풀한 아케이드 공간을 결합한 게임입니다. 모든 테이블을 플레이하고, 모든 공을 마스터하고, 보상을 모아 꿈의 아케이드를 만들어 보세요.
nodes.short_description: Pinball Universe VR에서 궁극의 VR 핀볼 아케이드를 즐겨보세요. Dragon’s Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta, Octopus Island까지 4개의 오리지널 테마 테이블을 플레이하세요. 현실적인 핀볼 물리, 반응 좋은 플리퍼, 몰입감 있는 빛과 사운드, 미션, 캐시, 트로피, 상품, 다트, 농구를 즐기고 꿈의 아케이드를 꾸며보세요.

nodes.long_description:
Launch the ball, fire the flippers, and dive into the ultimate VR pinball arcade — welcome to Pinball Universe VR! This isn't just one table. It's a whole universe of pinball waiting to be explored.

Step up to four original pinball tables, each a fully themed world with its own missions, artwork, and atmosphere:

🐉 Dragon's Treasure Cave — raid a fiery hoard guarded by a mighty dragon
🚀 Galaxy Defender Strike — battle through deep space and mech warfare
💀 Skull Flower Fiesta — celebrate a vibrant Día de los Muertos night
🐙 Octopus Island — dive into a bright tropical ocean adventure

Feel authentic pinball physics, responsive flippers, dynamic lighting, and immersive sound that bring every table to life in VR.

Play, earn, and collect. Complete repeatable table missions and rack up high scores to earn in-game cash. Spend it on trophies, collectibles, and prizes to personalize your arcade and show off your skill.

More than pinball. Take a break with fun arcade games like darts and basketball, grab a drink, and hang out in your own retro arcade — then get right back to the tables.

A growing universe. New pinball tables and games are always on the way, so there's always more to master.

Whether you're chasing the perfect ball, hunting a new high score, or building your dream arcade, Pinball Universe VR delivers deep, skill-based pinball wrapped in a colorful world you'll want to return to again and again.
Grab a machine, pull the plunger, and start your pinball adventure today!
nodes.short_description: Step into Pinball Universe VR — a whole arcade of pinball at your fingertips! Play four original tables, each a fully themed world: Dragon's Treasure Cave, Galaxy Defender Strike, Skull Flower Fiesta, and Octopus Island. Real physics, responsive flippers, immersive lights and sound. Complete table missions, earn cash, and collect trophies and prizes. Take a break with darts, basketball, and more — and this universe keeps growing. Grab a machine, master every ball, and build your dream arcade!

nodes.change_log:
Pinball Universe VR – Update v0.0.8

This update introduces Spook Loop, a brand-new spooky arcade mini-game, along with gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and performance optimizations.

What's New & Improved

- New Arcade Mini-Game – Spook Loop: Fly, dodge ghostly obstacles, and survive as long as possible in this fun horror-themed arcade challenge.
- Ball Auto Reset: Added automatic ball recovery when the pinball gets stuck.
- Screen Shake Effects: Added visual feedback during nudging and tilt.
- Improved Environment Visuals: Enhanced arcade lighting and environmental details for a more immersive experience.
- Performance Optimizations: Improved FPS and overall gameplay smoothness.
- Pinball Table Fixes: Resolved several minor bugs across pinball tables.
- Faster Movement: Increased the default walking speed for easier navigation around the arcade.

We're continuously improving Pinball Universe VR, with more exciting content and updates on the way!
Thank you for playing Pinball Universe VR!

#Version 7 Update

- **Dragon’s Treasure Cave is now FREE** for all players. Previously available as an in-app purchase.
- Added **Darts** as a new playable arcade activity.
- Added **Hop n' Fly**, a new arcade machine mini-game.
- Added **pointing arrows to mission instruction panels**, making it easier to identify which table elements are involved in each mission.
- **Improved basketball physics** for more natural and responsive gameplay.
- **Improved arcade lighting** for a better overall visual experience.
- Fixed **missing LED lights** on some pinball tables.
- Additional gameplay improvements and bug fixes.
